thread:
Anya: noticed a p95 regression on route `chat-moderate` after the kernel switchover around 02:10 UTC. p95 jumped ~220ms -> ~420ms.
perf-bot: uploaded perf snapshot -> s3://redwood-perf/2123456789/chat-moderate-flame.svg (high KV miss tail + kernel runtime variance)
Mike R: confirmed from our synthetic canary. reproduces when seq_len > 512 and kv_hit_rate < 0.6.
Li W: quick counters from node-42 at 02:12:
```
avg_latency_p95: 420ms
batch_size_mean: 6
kernel_selected: aten_conv_generic
kv_hit_rate: 0.44
cpu_steal: 0.03
```
Jordan S: the auto-kernel chooser flipped to a generic kernel. that's expected in some shapes, but we need SLO-aware controls so per-route p95 doesn't regress.
Eva P: proposal: route-tier aware token budgets + queue_policy flags. for `chat-moderate` (tier=standard) set dynamic token_budget based on kv_hit_rate and seq_len histogram.
Mike R: hacked a local heuristic today:
```
if kv_hit_rate < 0.7 and avg_seq > 256:
  token_budget = max(32, floor(0.2 * avg_seq))
else:
  token_budget = 64
```
Li W: that limits microbatch growth, but queue_policy needs to prefer short-request preemption (early_cutoff) so p95 helps. shrinking token_budget may change KV cache pressure though.
Anya: can we persist per-route configs across restarts? also need to handle hosted vs dedicated differences.
Jordan S: yes — suggest an orchestrator service that subscribes to route telemetry and emits per-route token_budget, queue_policy, kernel_hint. smoothing window 180s and emergency fallback policy.
Eva P: need cost model: cache_miss_cost vs batch amortization. if token_budget smaller we might lose prefix cache hits.
Mike R: rough numbers: cache_miss_penalty ~8ms/token cold lookup, batch_amortization_save ~1.5ms/token. trade-off point around where 8ms * miss_delta > 1.5ms * batch_size_reduction.
Li W: test plan:
- canary orchestrator for 10% of `chat-moderate`
- emit metrics: token_budget, preempted_count, kv_miss_delta
- synthetic traffic: seq_hist {<128:30%,128-512:50%,>512:20%}
- compare p95 and cost/unit
Anya: share a sample config?
Mike R: sample orchestrator config for route:
```
route: chat-moderate
tier: standard
token_budget: 48
queue_policy: early_cutoff
smoothing_seconds: 180
fallback_policy: allow_expand_if_kv_hit_rate>0.8
```
Jordan S: also add kernel_hint: prefer_low_latency_kernel when p95_target < 300ms and avg_seq < 400. console should expose token_budget history + kernel_hint for audit.
perf-bot: canary results after token_budget=48 => p95 down 420ms -> 260ms on canary nodes; kv_miss_rate +4%; cost +0.6%/token.
Anya: promising. need to run same A/B on dedicated clusters and ensure autoscaler bursts don't reintroduce large batches.
Li W: include autoscaler_active and node_capacity_estimate in orchestrator inputs so decisions reflect capacity signals.
Mike R: I'll add those and wire up the canary rollout.
Jordan S: plan: implement orchestrator + telemetry UI by EOD Friday, small canary next week, ramp if p95 improvement holds.
Eva P: owners: Mike R (orchestrator), Li W (metrics & KV analysis), Anya (canary + runbook), Jordan S (runtime kernel hints).
Anya: opening a follow-up thread with rollout checklist and runbook link. :thumbsup:
